decisions: D1 the PLR-066 call-site tests need a loop that delivers less than it was asked for without an error, which no reachable input produces (that is the loop invariant the receipts rely on); the seam is cfg(test) only (V4-04): model::short_loop, a thread-local shortfall applied by one `#[cfg(test)] let loop_end = short_loop::bound(loop_end);` line in each of the five loops (wav, y4m, PCM, mxf clip slices, mxf coded positions); no product build contains it. The tests live in src/delivery_tests.rs (cfg(test) module) because the seam is crate-private; it includes the integration tests' own synthetic builders through #[path] (tests/common/mod.rs), so there is no second copy of the fixtures

D2 the y4m past-end check is Export only: a y4m header declares no frame count, and the existing, unedited contract tests (foundation_contract wav_and_y4m_exact_truncated_and_bounded, v4_hardening y4m cases) pin a Preview of a range past the last complete frame as frames-then-Truncated { delivered }; the DESCRIPTOR claim is an Export rule, so the code now matches it and the Preview behaviour is kept and pinned (the every-provider test asserts Truncated { delivered: 1 } with one frame at the sink)

D3 in y4m the range check moved ahead of require_exact_start: an Export that is both unaligned and past the end is OutOfRange (as in wav, PCM and mxf), not NotExact; pinned in the y4m part of the every-provider test

D4 definition of the end of actual: wav/PCM the loop cursor, y4m start + frames counted, mxf start + delivered edit units (equal to the end of the requested range whenever everything was delivered, which is every reachable mxf/wav/y4m/PCM result), isobmff packets the latest pts + duration of a delivered non-preroll chunk; requested.end_pts is the request's own end at every site (isobmff: the end of the last presented entry of the requested range)

D5 the mxf coded path cannot name WHICH requested positions are missing in an unreachable shortfall, so its actual span is `start .. start + delivered`; that is a definition, documented at the site, not a claim about positions
residuals: R1 NEW video route: a Partial receipt caused by a decoder that dropped a picture (video.rs:520-532, pictures delivered < count) keeps actual.end_pts of the packet receipt (the end of the packets), only actual.units follows the pictures; the end of the last delivered PICTURE is known only to Forward (video.rs:272-368, off-limits to this lane while SMB-REEL-AV1-ROUTE is at 2/3 failed verdicts, 'Forward ... not to be touched'). Candidate PLR for the lead: track the latest picture end in Forward (or a sink wrapper) and set receipt.actual.end_pts from it

R2 the y4m Preview of a range past the last complete frame still streams the frames that exist and ends Truncated { delivered } (D2); a consumer that wants OutOfRange there needs a decision to edit the existing contract tests
R3 the shortfall branches of the wav, y4m, PCM and mxf receipts remain unreachable on real input (loop invariants); they are proven by the cfg(test) seam, not by an input file
R4 REEL-R11-4 (slot table and pre-roll sized by the media-sample span of the range, not its count) is a separate open item, not part of this lane
